brief: lanzamiento de mi marca de ropa sostenible, un video de 30 segundos

context.audience: women 20-35 in Latin America who care where clothes come from

concept: Every garment starts as a field: we follow one shirt back from the street to the cotton.
plan_outline: 1. MS · eye · track · busy city street, morning · a young woman in a natural linen shirt walks toward camera (3 s, the hook)
2. CU · eye · static · sewing workshop, window light · hands guiding fabric through a sewing machine (3 s)
3. ECU · eye · static · dye vats · fabric lifted out of an indigo bath, dripping (3 s)
4. WS · eye · crane · cotton field at golden hour · a woman farmer walks the rows (5 s)
5. MCU · eye · push in · same field · the farmer smiles at camera, sun behind her (4 s)
6. Match cut · MS · same framing as shot 1 · the woman on the street touches her shirt's collar and smiles (3 s)
7. End card (page) · logo and the user's Spanish line (3 s)
why: The journey backwards gives the brand's claim a story without stating it.
A match cut back to shot 1 closes the loop the hook opened.
Real makers are invented people unless the brand provides its own; no claims beyond what the user says.
